name: Sugar
source:
Naotsuka Fumiya starts learning at a beginners patisserie school so he can get closer to his infatuation, Ayuhara. However, the more he learns about this guy, the more reality diverges from the idealistic image he held of Ayuhara.
To make matters more complicated,
he meets two other guys at the patisserie school--- Sawadaishi and Eita.
Naotsuka's heart is now torn between three love interests.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE186869.html]DLsite English[/url]]
